content: sqlite3.connect(timeout=N) sets the busy timeout in SECONDS (default 5.0): 'How many seconds the connection should wait before raising an OperationalError when a table is locked.' PRAGMA busy_timeout=<ms> sets the same underlying sqlite busy handler — the last one applied wins. Locally verified: connect(timeout=0.3) waited ~0.37s before raising; setting PRAGMA busy_timeout=100 afterwards shortened the wait to ~0.14s. Ordering implication: execute the PRAGMA after connect so it is authoritative.
